description: This file manages remote node skills, including registry setup, cache priming, node info management, bin collection and verification, and remote skill eligibility for macOS nodes.

methods.name: describeNode
methods.description: Generates a descriptive string for a remote node based on its ID.

methods.name: extractErrorMessage
methods.description: Extracts a human-readable message from various error object types.

methods.name: logRemoteBinProbeFailure
methods.description: Logs failures during remote binary probing with different severity based on error type.

methods.name: isMacPlatform
methods.description: Checks if the platform or device family indicates a macOS system.

methods.name: supportsSystemRun
methods.description: Determines if a command list supports 'system.run'.

methods.name: supportsSystemWhich
methods.description: Determines if a command list supports 'system.which'.

methods.name: upsertNode
methods.description: Adds or updates a remote node record in the internal map.

methods.name: setSkillsRemoteRegistry
methods.description: Sets the remote node registry object.

methods.name: primeRemoteSkillsCache
methods.description: Initializes the cache of remote nodes by listing paired nodes and updating the internal map.

methods.name: recordRemoteNodeInfo
methods.description: Records or updates information about a remote node.

methods.name: recordRemoteNodeBins
methods.description: Updates the bins associated with a remote node.

methods.name: removeRemoteNodeInfo
methods.description: Removes a remote node from the internal map and updates snapshot if necessary.

methods.name: collectRequiredBins
methods.description: Collects required binary names from skill entries for a specific platform.

methods.name: buildBinProbeScript
methods.description: Constructs a shell script to check for the presence of binaries.

methods.name: parseBinProbePayload
methods.description: Parses the payload from a bin probe command to extract binary names.

methods.name: areBinSetsEqual
methods.description: Checks if two sets of binaries are equal.

methods.name: refreshRemoteNodeBins
methods.description: Refreshes the list of binaries available on a remote node, updating metadata and snapshot if changed.

methods.name: getRemoteSkillEligibility
methods.description: Provides context about remote macOS nodes and their available binaries for skill execution.

methods.name: refreshRemoteBinsForConnectedNodes
methods.description: Triggers bin refresh for all connected remote nodes.
